Price ko hilata kaun hai, aur rokta kaun? ⚡

Aggressive trader market order se book ko khata hai, isliye price hilta hai. Passive trader apni jagah baitha rehta hai, wahi price ko rok sakta hai. Har move in dono ki ladaai hai.
